legalAcceptableUse.intro: Kairos is the internal platform Kharis Church uses to keep in touch with its members, run fellowships and departments, and support pastoral care. Because Kairos holds real information about real people, everyone who signs in agrees to a shared set of rules for how they will behave inside the platform. This policy sets out those rules.

legalAcceptableUse.appliesToEveryPerson: This policy applies to every person who signs into Kairos: members of Kharis Church, fellowship and department leaders, branch administrators, and any volunteer or member of staff who has been granted access. legalAcceptableUse.chooseAPasswordYouDoNotUse: Choose a password you do not use anywhere else, and where offered, turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA).
legalAcceptableUse.youAreResponsibleForEverything: You are responsible for everything done under your account. If you believe someone has used your account without your permission, tell us at once at
legalAcceptableUse.kairosMayShowYouPersonalInformation: Kairos may show you personal information about other members, for example the phone number of someone in your fellowship, a new-believer’s discipleship notes, or a child’s emergency contact. That information is entrusted to you for one purpose only: to help you serve your role in the church.
legalAcceptableUse.specialCareAppliesToSafeguardingNotes: Special care applies to safeguarding notes, information about children, health information, and information about someone’s personal or family circumstances. Treat these with the highest level of confidentiality.

legalAcceptableUse.doNotConnectYourAccountToThirdParty: Do not connect your Kairos account to third-party services (browser extensions, integrations, bots) unless we have listed that integration as supported.

If we have reason to suspect a breach of this policy or of the law, a Branch Administrator or an appointed leader may review those logs. Any monitoring is carried out in line with our

legalAcceptableUse.weTreatReportsInConfidence: . We treat reports in confidence and will not penalise anyone for raising a concern in good faith.
legalAcceptableUse.followUpThroughPastoralProcesses: Follow up through the church’s pastoral and disciplinary processes.
legalAcceptableUse.reportSeriousMisuseToTheIco: Report serious misuse to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office, the Police, or another regulator where the law requires it.

legalPrivacy.intro: This notice explains how Kharis Church (“we”, “us”, “the church”) collects and uses your personal data when you use Kairos, our internal church administration platform. It is written to comply with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

legalPrivacy.whereAFormAsksAboutHealth: Where a form asks you to disclose information about your health, a disability, a child in your care, or a safeguarding concern, that information is treated with extra care. legalPrivacy.yourDataIsVisibleToLeaders: Your data is visible inside Kharis Church to leaders whose role requires it. Access is scoped so that leaders only see the data for the people and areas they are responsible for.

legalPrivacy.churchTakesSafeguardingSeriously: Kharis Church takes the safeguarding of children very seriously. If you are under 16, please ask a parent or guardian to complete Kairos-related forms on your behalf. Children’s records are created and managed by a parent or a designated safeguarding lead, and their visibility inside Kairos is restricted to leaders whose role requires them to see it. When a child reaches an appropriate age, we support them in taking over their own record.
